> [!WARNING]
> **Test build.** The PC version moves from Lichii's build 130 (v1.2) to build 228 with all of this fork's new work. Keep
> [v1.2](https://github.com/elkarbeenus/LakuenPlay/releases/tag/v1.2) if something runs worse, and please say so.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Coming from v1.2 or older: download this one by hand, once, and do not accept the update those versions offer.**
> Their update check looked at Lichii's releases and would replace LaküenPlay with Lichii. From v1.3 on, LaküenPlay
> updates itself from this repository: it says when a newer LaküenPlay for the PC is out, downloads it, replaces itself and
> starts again.

**LaküenPlay v1.3 – PC** is the PC build of the same code as the handheld v1.0.5: Lichii's build 228, this fork's memory
work, the master log and updates inside the program.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is an unofficial fork, not an official Lichii release. Please report problems [here](https://github.com/elkarbeenus/LakuenPlay/issues), not upstream. Games, keys and firmware are not included: only use content you have legally obtained.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.3-PC-x86_64-pgo.AppImage` | **Recommended.** Self-contained, compiled for x86-64-v3 (AVX2: Intel since Haswell, AMD since Excavator / Ryzen) with profile-guided optimization |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.3-PC-x86_64.AppImage` | The same program without PGO |
| `*.tar.gz` | Plain binaries that use your system libraries |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums |

## New since v1.2

- **Updates inside LaküenPlay** from this repository: PC builds update to PC builds, handheld builds to handheld builds;
  the matching AppImage (PGO or not) is downloaded, checked, swapped in, the previous kept for one rollback. The "Check for
  updates" setting turns it off.
- **The update check works on any distro:** the host's CA bundle is found at run time and the built-in roots go
  along with GitHub's download redirect ([#1842](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1842),
  [#1844](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1844)).
- **Lichii's builds 131 to 228:** among them the RDNA2 mesh fallback against GPU hangs on RADV
  ([#1732](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1732)), early read-back downloads
  ([#1795](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1795)), Loading Shaders waiting only for the last two sessions'
  pipelines ([#1803](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1803)), the texture cache giving old memory back
  ([#1731](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1731)), the log flushed every second
  ([#1771](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1771)), cloth and hair at real speed above 60 fps
  ([#1793](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1793)), and many more fixes.
- **This fork's work since v1.2:** the master log (`lakuen_master_log.txt`, the last five runs' frame rate, RAM and swap),
  the memory guard and heap trimming when the host runs low, pipeline eviction when memory is critical, two open Lichii
  pull requests for the GPU thread's CPU time ([#1641](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1641),
  [#1597](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1597)).
- **Built for x86-64-v3** (v1.2: the compiler's default x86-64): AVX2 and FMA in the hot loops. A CPU without AVX2 needs v1.2.
